newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BIAGGIO SET TO RETURN TO ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BIAGGIO SET TO RETURN TO ARGENTINA.

text.p: Argentine striker Claudio Biaggio, who joined Bordeaux at the start of the French season, looks set to return to former club San Lorenzo.
Bordeaux sources said on Tuesday San Lorenzo officials were expected in France at the weekend to discuss Biaggo's future.
Biaggio, who scored 46 goals in his last three seasons in Argentina but failed to win a regular first team place in Jean-Pierre Papin's team, could return to San Lorenzo on loan.
Capped once by Argentina, he cost Bordeaux seven million francs ($1.4 million) in July when he signed a three-year contract.
